tip.title: How to study
tip.text: Learn the examples aloud, complete the quiz, then produce your own answer without copying the model.

sections.title: Core words and phrases
sections.description: Flip each card, listen, and create one personal example.

cards.definition: Lan invited us to her party.

tip.title: Recall practice
tip.text: Cover the English term, read the Vietnamese meaning, and retrieve the full phrase from memory.

sections.title: Grammar bridge
sections.description: Master the structures that connect this A2 module to the next stage.

points.title: Past simple: regular verbs
points.function: Add -ed for finished actions; learn spelling changes.

points.title: Irregular verbs
points.function: Common verbs change form and must be learned.

points.title: Questions and negatives
points.function: Use did/didn’t plus the base verb.

tip.title: Accuracy first
tip.text: Notice the verb form in every example, then change the subject or time expression to make a new sentence.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.description: Choose the best answer, then read the explanation.

questions.prompt: We ___ to the museum last Saturday.
questions.explanation: Went is the past form of go.
Use Did for a past simple question.
After did not, use the base verb.

questions.prompt: They ___ at the hotel at 9 p.m.
questions.explanation: Arrived describes a finished past action.

questions.prompt: I ___ a new bag at the market.
questions.explanation: Bought is the irregular past of buy.

questions.prompt: ___, a stranger helped us find the station.

tip.title: Use the clue
tip.text: Look for time expressions, the subject, and words before or after the gap before choosing.

sections.title: Build a spoken answer
sections.description: Answer each question aloud. Aim for a clear answer plus one reason or detail.
questions: What did you do last weekend?
When did something unexpected happen to you?
sections.sampleAnswer: Last weekend, I visited my grandparents. We cooked lunch and talked for hours. On Sunday, I missed my bus, but fortunately my uncle drove me home.

tip.title: Speak in layers
tip.text: Start with a direct answer, add a reason, then give one example or detail.

sections.title: Independent writing
sections.description: Tell a friend about a memorable weekend.

prompt.situation: Explain where you went, what happened, and how you felt.
prompt.referenceAnswer: Last weekend, I visited my grandparents. We cooked lunch and talked for hours. On Sunday, I missed my bus, but fortunately my uncle drove me home.

tip.title: Final check
tip.text: Check verb forms, word order, spelling, and whether every sentence helps answer the task.
